01 · ACCOUNT & WORKSPACE

Account and workspace
1
Sign-in account

Sign in with an existing account. If public registration is enabled for this deployment, you can create a username and password from the sign-in page. When GitHub sign-in is configured, you can also create an account on your first sign-in. After signing in, open the Dashboard to see accessible projects; the server checks project and source access by role.

2
Understand roles

Workspace Owners and Admins manage members, invitations, and project grants for their workspace only. Members and Viewers can access projects granted to them. The system administrator console is platform-wide and does not imply workspace permissions.

3
Accept invitation

Send invitation links through a secure channel. The invited account must have a matching email address and accept before the link expires. Username-and-password self-registration does not collect email, so it cannot accept email invitations or use email-based password recovery. Different sign-in identities are never merged automatically, even if they share an email address.

02 · PROJECTS

Create a project workspace
1
Confirm creation access first

Only the current workspace Owner or Admin can create projects; a system administrator role does not automatically grant workspace access. A Member or Viewer must be authorized by the workspace Owner or Admin first.

2
Create from project entry

If you have permission, select Dashboard or “Projects” at the top, choose “New project,” and enter a project name and optional description. Each project keeps its sources, plan, AI usage, memory, and audit separate. Projects do not maintain independent model routes.

3
Confirm access scope

Only users with the project Owner or Editor role can change content; Viewers can read it. Archived projects are read-only until restored.

Project data boundaries

Do not put passwords, Tokens, private keys or other credentials in project descriptions, sources or items. Handle project exports as sensitive business data.

03 · OVERVIEW

Project overview
1
Read current status

The overview uses active confirmed facts, questions, risks, relationships and plan health to calculate project status. It does not guess with a model or automatically confirm candidates.

2
Continue from current status

Review key project metrics, the suggested next step and current status, then open configuration, plans, sources, the AI workspace or automation. Task runs and AI usage are also available from the overview.

3
View historical evidence

Fact cards show sources, revisions, and evidence. Retired sources and expired or superseded facts remain in history but do not affect the current state.

04 · CONFIGURATION

Project settings
1
Review project connections

View repository, MCP and AI connections for this project. Under Repositories, select an existing grant or add a connection, test the repository and branch, then save. After submitting the read scope, both the connection owner and project Owner must confirm it.

2
Understand rule priority

Project settings determine the connections and capabilities available to that project. Project rules take precedence over personal defaults.

3
Keep authorization minimal

Connection delegations and tool authorizations are stored per project. Removing a project authorization does not delete the personal connection itself.

04 · PLAN

Project plan
1
Create work item

Set an owner, target date, and acceptance criteria for each goal and work item. Work cannot start while required details are missing.

2
Linked evidence

Select completion evidence from confirmed facts or active sources. Repository changes produce a deterministic change list and never update the plan automatically.

3
Manually advance status

Editors and Owners update work items as needed. Plans do not run code, create Git branches, invoke a shell, or deploy automatically.

05 · MATERIALS

Project sources
1
Add source

Add text, files, folders, and web pages under Project sources. View linked code repositories on the repositories page. The list stays compact; open a source to read its full content and provenance.

2
Review recognition result

After image recognition or scanned-file processing finishes, confirm the usable text in Sources. Sync, parsing, and recognition failures retain a safe error message and do not write incomplete content.

3
Organize, ask questions, and review tasks

Confirm the organization scope in the import dialog and submit it to the background. Track progress and cancel eligible tasks under Recognition tasks; review the content under Organization results. Ask questions from Ask AI Open a conversation and switch between personal and project scopes. Review the model, scope and billing terms in the composer; sending authorizes this turn. Each turn retains its citations. View question history Conversations are saved in your account, with citations kept at the version used for the answer.

External processing confirmation

Recognition, organization, indexing and brief generation retain their own review and confirmation flows. Ask AI shows the provider, model, source scope and billing terms in the composer. Sending authorizes this question, relevant sources and conversation history; the server still checks permissions and sources. Personal models do not automatically replace the platform default.

Upload boundaries

This deployment limits each selection to 10 files; file size: Unlimited. Files are stored as streams; processing limits still apply. Retained files continue to count toward capacity after soft deletion. Deployment capacity is 20 GiB。

06 · ASK & AI WORKBENCH

Ask AI and workspace
1
Open unified Ask AI

Pass Ask AI Open a conversation and switch between all accessible content, personal space and a project. Review the scope, model and billing terms in the composer; sending authorizes this turn. Each turn retains its citations, and failures or unavailable models show an explanation.

2
View retrieval and indexing

Semantic search shows source excerpts, paths, versions, and scores. Rebuild the vector index from the page when sources or the active model change.

3
Generate a brief and run research

View platform defaults or capabilities with completed personal delegation confirmations. Confirm the transfer scope before generating a brief. Briefs cite current status, facts and evidence without overwriting deterministic status. The agent can organize evidence, suggest next steps and show uncertainty, but has no Shell, code write, Git write, MCP write or deployment permissions.

07 · AUTOMATION

Automations
1
Review the impact preview first

A project Owner can configure web refresh, memory quality, and plan health alerts after confirming the first UTC run time, browser time zone (display only), interval, scope, and recipients. Read-only Git schedules require separate authorization on the project Git page and confirmation from both the connection owner and project Owner.

2
Understand approval checkpoints

Indexing and brief rules create only waitingConsent notifications: they do not select a model, charge credits, or send project content. Each notification links to the AI workspace, where you can confirm individual actions.

3
View runs and failures

The rule shows its latest result, next run, and consecutive failures. A partial failure among web sources marks the run as failed while preserving success and failure counts. Check the safe error code and recommended next step; do not treat an unknown result as success.

08 · GOVERNANCE

Project governance and usage
1
Review memory candidates

Open the project-source review queue and check each title, content item, and source citation. Only confirmed items become trusted facts; rejected items remain in the review history.

2
Governance relationships and status

Owners and Editors with permission can open advanced state governance from the project overview to create fact relationships, resolve conflicts, supersede old facts, and capture the current state. Relationships stay pinned to the original revision and do not silently follow newer versions.

3
Review actions and usage

Controlled actions require policies and approval. AI usage in the project overview reports only audited calls and tokens; final charges are determined by the provider's bill. An administrator must review each MCP tool's exact definition before the project owner manages connection delegation and read-only tool authorization. In controlled environments, each read-only action requires approval, and results need manual confirmation before import. Production enablement and real external services still require acceptance testing.

09 · NOTIFICATIONS & REVIEW

Notifications and memory confirmations
1
View notification

Notifications link to tasks, approvals, and candidate reviews. Opening details marks the notification as read; its history remains available under All.

2
Back from task details

The Back button on a regular task detail page returns to the parent project page where the task originated, or to the notification center if opened from a notification. Task results show only a safe summary, not the raw payload.

3
Review candidate

When extraction succeeds and produces candidates, the task details provide an option to review them. Confirm or reject candidates individually or in a batch; the page refreshes using the latest server state.

Personal connections and platform capability boundaries

Manage repository connections and read scopes under Project configuration → Repositories. Personal space → Configuration → Git grants manages personal credentials, project use and revocation. Open personal MCP connections from Personal space; personal settings do not provide administrator tool certification or project grants. Project Git supports one-time manual read-only access after both parties confirm, and separately confirmed scheduled read-only access. Writes, commits and legacy PAT access remain disabled. Controlled environments support per-call MCP approvals and manual result imports; production availability still requires acceptance. System administrators manage platform models and membership policies.

TROUBLESHOOTING

Common questions
Action unavailable

Check the project role, required fields, platform default model or individually confirmed delegation, and transfer confirmation first. Viewers cannot make changes.

The task has no result

Refresh task details to check the worker status and safe error code. Unknown results require manual resolution and are never changed to success automatically.

Sources have changed

Open Ask AI, select the personal or project scope, review the model and billing terms, then send.

No notifications received

Only users with access to the relevant project receive notifications. Opening details marks a record as read; it remains available under All.

01 · ACCOUNT & WORKSPACE

账号与工作区
1
登录账号

可使用已有账号登录；部署启用公开注册后，也可从登录页创建用户名密码账号。已配置 GitHub 登录时可通过该入口首次登录建号。登录后在 Dashboard 查看可访问项目；项目和资料权限由服务端按角色判断。

2
理解角色

workspace Owner/Admin 只管理所属工作区成员、邀请和项目授权；Member/Viewer 按被授予的项目访问。系统管理员的管理工作台属于平台范围，不等同于工作区权限。

3
接受邀请

邀请链接应通过安全渠道发送，并在有效期内由匹配邮箱的账号接受。用户名密码自注册不收集邮箱，不能直接接受邮箱邀请或通过邮箱自助找回密码；相同邮箱也不会自动合并不同登录身份。

02 · PROJECTS

创建项目空间
1
先确认创建权限

只有当前工作区 Owner/Admin 可以创建项目；系统管理员角色不会自动获得工作区权限。普通 Member/Viewer 需要由当前工作区 Owner/Admin 授权后再创建。

2
从项目入口创建

有权限时点击 Dashboard 或顶部“项目”，选择“新建项目”，填写项目名称和可选描述。新项目会隔离自己的资料、计划、AI 能力使用方式、记忆和审计；项目内不维护独立模型路由。

3
确认访问范围

只有被授予项目 Owner/Editor 的用户才能修改内容；Viewer 可以查看。项目归档后变为只读，恢复后才可继续操作。

项目数据边界

不要把密码、Token、私钥或其他凭据录入项目描述、资料或条目。项目导出也应按敏感业务数据保管。

03 · OVERVIEW

项目概览
1
读取当前状态

概览显示当前有效、已确认事实，以及问题、风险、关系和计划健康度计算出的项目状态。它不是模型猜测，也不会自动把候选变成事实。

2
从状态进入下一步

查看项目关键指标、推荐下一步和当前状态后，可继续进入配置、计划、资料、AI 工作台或自动化。任务运行记录与 AI 用量也集中在概览中。

3
查看历史依据

事实卡片可查看来源、修订和证据。来源退役、事实过期或被替代的内容会保留在历史中，但不参与当前状态。

04 · CONFIGURATION

项目配置
1
核对项目连接

查看当前项目的代码仓库、MCP 与 AI 连接。进入“代码仓库”选择已有授权或添加连接，先测试指定仓库和分支再保存；填写项目读取范围并提交后，仍需连接所有者与项目 Owner 分别确认。

2
理解规则优先级

项目配置决定该项目可用的连接和能力，项目规则优先于个人默认规则。

3
保持最小授权

连接委托和工具授权按项目保存；移除项目授权不会删除个人连接本身。

04 · PLAN

项目计划
1
建立工作项

为目标和工作项填写负责人、目标日期和验收标准。缺少必要信息时，工作项不能开始。

2
关联证据

从已确认事实或活动来源选择完成证据；仓库变化只生成确定性变化清单，不会自动修改计划。

3
人工推进状态

Editor/Owner 根据实际情况更新工作项。计划不会自动运行代码、创建 Git 分支、调用 Shell 或部署。

05 · MATERIALS

项目资料
1
接入来源

在“项目资料”添加文本、文件、文件夹和网页；已关联的代码仓库在仓库页查看。列表保持精简；点击资料进入详情查看完整正文和来源定位。

2
处理识别结果

图片或扫描文件完成识别后，在资料区确认可用文本。来源同步、解析和识别失败会保留安全错误提示，不会写入不完整内容。

3
整理、提问与查看任务

在导入窗口确认整理范围后提交后台，在“识别任务”查看进度和允许取消的任务；“整理结果”集中核对内容。提问统一从 智能问答 进入；同一会话可切换个人或项目范围，在输入框核对模型、范围和计量条款，点击发送即授权本轮，历史记录保留当轮引用，查看问答历史。会话保存在账户中，引用保留回答时的版本。

外发确认

识别、整理、索引和简报等操作按各自页面核对并确认后发送。智能问答在输入框展示本轮供应商、模型、资料范围和计量条款，点击发送即授权本轮问题、相关资料与历史上下文；服务端仍核对权限和来源。个人模型不会自动替代平台默认模型。

上传边界

当前部署会限制单次选择 10 个文件；单文件大小：不限。文件逐个流式保存；解析仍有处理上限。软删除但仍保留的文件继续计入容量预算。整套部署上限为 20 GiB。

06 · ASK & AI WORKBENCH

智能问答与 AI 工作台
1
打开统一问答入口

通过 智能问答 进入统一会话。同一会话可切换全量、个人或项目范围；在输入框核对范围、模型与计量条款，点击发送即授权本轮请求。历史记录保留该轮引用来源，模型不可用或调用失败时显示原因。

2
查看检索与索引

语义检索展示原文片段、路径、版本和分数。资料或有效模型来源变化后，可按页面入口重建向量索引。

3
生成简报并运行调查

查看平台默认或已完成个人双确认委托的能力，确认传输范围后生成简报。简报会引用当前状态、事实和证据，不会覆盖确定性状态。智能体可整理证据、提出建议并显示不确定性，但没有 Shell、代码写入、Git 写入、MCP 写操作或部署权限。

07 · AUTOMATION

项目自动化
1
先看影响预览

项目 Owner 可以在确认首次 UTC 时间、浏览器时区（仅展示）、间隔、作用范围和通知对象后，设置网页刷新、记忆质量和计划健康提醒。Git 计划只读在项目 Git 页面另行授权，需要连接所有者和项目 Owner 双确认。

2
理解审批停点

索引和简报规则只创建 waitingConsent 通知，不选模型、不扣费、不发送项目内容；通知中会提供进入 AI 工作台的入口，由你逐次确认。

3
查看运行与失败

规则显示最近结果、下次运行和连续失败次数。网页来源部分失败会标记整次运行失败，并保留成功/失败数量；先查看安全错误码和下一步建议，不要把未知结果当作成功。

08 · GOVERNANCE

项目治理与用量
1
审核记忆候选

进入项目资料的审核队列，逐条核对标题、内容和原文引用。确认后才会进入可信事实，驳回会保留审核记录。

2
治理关系和状态

有权限的 Owner/Editor 可从项目概览进入高级状态治理，建立事实关系、处理冲突、替代旧事实和固化当前状态快照。关系固定当时的修订，不会静默跟随新版本。

3
核对动作与用量

受控动作需要策略和审批；项目概览中的 AI 用量只表示审计到的调用与 Token，最终费用以供应商账单为准。MCP 工具须先由管理员审核精确定义，项目 Owner 再管理连接委托和只读工具授权；受控环境中只读动作逐次审批，结果经人工确认后才可导入。生产启用与真实外部服务仍需验收。

09 · NOTIFICATIONS & REVIEW

通知与记忆确认
1
查看通知

通知中心按任务、审批和候选审核提供入口。点击“查看详情”会自动将通知标为已读；历史记录仍可在“全部”中查看。

2
从任务详情返回

普通任务详情的返回按钮回到产生它的上一级项目页面；从通知进入时则返回通知中心。任务结果只显示安全摘要，不展示原始载荷。

3
处理候选

自动抽取成功且有候选时，任务详情会提供“进入候选审核”。在候选区逐条或批量确认/驳回，页面会按服务器最新状态刷新。

个人连接与平台能力边界

代码仓库接入和读取范围在“项目配置 → 代码仓库”管理；“我的空间 → 配置 → Git 授权管理”维护个人凭据、查看项目使用情况和撤权。MCP 个人连接从“我的空间”进入；个人配置页面不提供管理员工具认证或项目授权。项目 Git 支持双确认后的一次性手动只读读取，以及单独双确认后的计划只读读取；写入/提交和旧 PAT 路径保持关闭。MCP 连接委托与只读动作在受控环境支持逐次审批和结果人工导入，生产开放仍需验收。平台模型与会员策略由系统管理员维护。

按钮不可用

先检查项目角色、必填字段、平台默认模型或个人双确认委托及传输确认。Viewer 没有写入权限。

任务没有结果

刷新任务详情，确认 Worker 状态和安全错误码。未知结果需要人工收口，不会自动改成成功。

资料有更新

打开智能问答，选择本轮个人或项目范围，核对模型与计量条款后点击发送。

没有收到通知

通知只发送给有对应项目权限的用户。打开通知详情后会标为已读；在“全部”中仍可查看该记录。
